<!-- pr-reviewer: 4924b9d831e967ca207d8b6ab07133879eaa3223 -->
Needs changes before merge.

The worker sends MCP calls to the UI thread. The tests check Allow and Deny before posting NC output. I used the safety review checks because this change adds a path to `post` and to document edits. No golden files changed.

Local results, with this head trial-merged with `upstream/main` at `a277dd9d51e7b4488403b946d0a3234b71ba7504`:

- `cargo test -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --no-run`: passed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib`, from `crates/ui`: 870 passed, 0 failed, 6 ignored. This includes all 11 AI Chat tests.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --test shell`, from `crates/ui`: 21 passed.
- App tests: `commands_undo`: 30 passed; `mcp_live`: 10 passed; `mcp_provider`: 9 passed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- Mutation 1: set the native confirmation result to false. `post_confirmation_allow_and_deny_gate_mcp_dispatch` failed with `timed out waiting for inline Allow/Deny confirmation prompt`. Restore the source: the test passed.
- Mutation 2: remove the history-depth check. `undo_turn_is_disabled_and_refused_after_later_manual_edit` failed with `later manual edit must disable Undo Turn`. Restore the source: the test passed.

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/ai_chat/turn.rs:82`: Identify the commands that belong to the turn. Stack length is not sufficient. After an AI turn adds one command, use normal Undo, then make a manual edit. The stack has the same length as before, so Undo Turn becomes enabled and can undo the manual edit. A temporary review test used this sequence and failed with `later manual edit must disable Undo Turn`. Bind the turn to the exact history entries and document. Add a test for replacement at the same depth.
2. `crates/ui/src/mcp_host.rs:19` and `crates/ui/src/state.rs:3023`: Reject queued AI calls from a previous document or a cancelled turn. New stops the worker, but keeps its inbox. `drain_actions` then runs the queued call against the new document. A temporary review test queued `add_tool`, then selected New. The tool was added to the new document: history length was 1, expected 0. The successful Open path also leaves the worker active. Stop the worker on document replacement, discard its queued requests, and invalidate old turn undo records. Add tests for New and Open with a queued call.
3. `crates/ui/src/state.rs:2908`: Send an actual viewport image when the user selects Attach screenshot. This path always calls `fallback_viewport_png`, which creates a solid-color 32 by 32 image. It contains no model or toolpath. Connect viewport capture, or disable the control with a clear message until capture is available. Check image content in the test; valid PNG encoding alone does not prove viewport capture.
4. PR body, for the UI change at `crates/ui/src/egui_app/ai_chat/panel.rs:14`: Add before and after screenshots. The body has neither. Store the images only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch and link them from the body. Do not add image or review evidence files to this PR branch.

The two temporary review tests failed on the original logic as described above. All temporary source edits were restored. No review files were committed. Live provider HTTP calls, the WebAssembly target, and GPU window rendering were not tested.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Fixed the four requested findings.

1. Undo Turn now checks exact history entries and document identity. `undo_turn_refuses_manual_replacement_at_the_same_history_depth` pins the reported sequence. Undo/Redo and interleaved-edit tests also pass.
2. New and successful Open stop the worker, discard its inbox, and invalidate turn undo records. Each new turn gets a fresh inbox. Cancelled calls are rejected before dispatch. Pins: `new_document_discards_queued_ai_call_and_stops_worker`, `open_document_discards_queued_ai_call_and_stops_worker`, and `cancellation_rejects_already_queued_ai_call`.
3. Attach screenshot is disabled with a visible capture-unavailable message. The solid-color fallback is removed. `screenshot_control_is_disabled_and_forced_attachment_refuses_submission` pins both the control and submission refusal.
4. The PR body now links before/after screenshots on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch. A link/content check verified both remote PNGs and failed when a link was removed. No images or review evidence were committed to this PR branch.

All 20 AI Chat tests pass. Seven code mutations failed as expected, then passed after restoration. `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` and clippy on app/UI with all targets and `-D warnings` passed.

New head: `5d1a38a69a57a51dc28a7644f7f12744349370d3`.

Please re-review this head.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 5d1a38a69a57a51dc28a7644f7f12744349370d3 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The four findings from the previous review are resolved:

1. Undo Turn checks the document identity and the exact history entries. The tests cover replacement at the same depth, interleaved edits, and Undo/Redo.
2. New and successful Open stop the worker, replace the inbox, and invalidate old undo records. The tests also cover queued calls after Cancel and calls from an earlier turn.
3. Attach screenshot is disabled. The panel shows that capture is unavailable. Forced submission with this attachment fails before transport starts.
4. The PR body links before and after screenshots. I downloaded and inspected both images. They show the panel and its disabled capture control. No image files are added to this PR.

I used the safety review checks because this change adds a path to posting and document edits. No golden files changed.

Local results, with this head trial-merged with `upstream/main` at `a277dd9d51e7b4488403b946d0a3234b71ba7504`:

- `cargo test -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --no-run`: passed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib`, from `crates/ui`: 879 passed, 0 failed, 6 ignored. All 20 AI Chat tests passed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --test shell`, from `crates/ui`: 21 passed.
- App suites: `commands_undo`: 30 passed; `mcp_live`: 10 passed; `mcp_provider`: 9 passed; `dirty_flag`: 2 passed.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --dry-run`: printed the app and UI plan. This command did not run the gate suites.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.

I repeated two mutation checks:

- Set native confirmation to false. `post_confirmation_allow_and_deny_gate_mcp_dispatch` failed with `timed out waiting for inline Allow/Deny confirmation prompt`. After source restoration, the test passed.
- Remove the exact entry check from `ChatTurn::can_undo`. `undo_turn_refuses_manual_replacement_at_the_same_history_depth` failed with `same-depth manual replacement must disable Undo Turn`. After source restoration, the test passed.

Both source files were restored byte for byte. No review evidence was committed. All builds and tests ran locally. No GitHub runner was used.

Requested before merge: none.

Notes: `state.rs` and `shell.rs` were already larger than the file-size guide. This change adds to them. This is not a blocker. Live HTTP transport, WebAssembly compilation, and GPU window rendering were not tested. The default transport still reports that no live endpoint is configured, as the PR body states.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
